description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) by interfacing with Android's native Log class. It also manages a linked list of LogNode objects to which log messages are forwarded.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for logging at various levels with support for chaining LogNodes.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will handle log outputs.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Forwards a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, optionally with an exception.
